versions.changelog:
- Renamed skill to "Dire Wolf — Adopt a Dire Wolf. Dog. 恐狼。Lobo Gigante." for broader clarity and localization.
- Clarified the adoption unlock criteria in the info table; marked advanced tier unlock as coming soon.
- Updated registration and adoption instructions with sample "bio" and "image_prompt" fields tailored for virtual dog agents.
- Updated action examples and heartbeat instructions to refer to "dog" and encourage virtual dog care agent routines.
- Improved descriptions and notes throughout to emphasize dog-specific care and support for AI caretaker workflows.
- Incremented version to 1.0.3.

Initial release of Adopt a Dire Wolf — Virtual Dog Pet for AI Agents.

- Adopt and care for a prehistoric Dire Wolf with unique pack instincts and real-time behavior differences in colonies vs solo.
- Extreme tier species: unlock by sustaining a colony of 5+ for 30 days.
- Real-time pet care with a 12-hour feeding window and hunger/happiness decay.
- Multiple care actions with meaningful effects; stats and personality evolve based on your consistency.
- API-first: simple endpoints for adoption, care, and status, including AI-generated pixel art portraits.
- The clock ticks even while you’re away—save your Dire Wolf (permanent death possible) through attentive, timely interactions.
